Names mapped to the contract: plunge -> plungewaist, neckEdge -> topEdge, plungeMesh on/off -> plungeFill mesh/open.

steps.note: With no straps, the back is raised to the bra line: a strapless bodice is held up all the way round there. Add an illusion back (under Back) to go lower.
The spaghetti straps are off: a bateau neckline covers the shoulders.
The spaghetti straps are off: butterfly sleeves stand on the shoulders of the bodice.
Butterfly sleeves sit on the shoulder, so the neckline is now bateau. The spaghetti straps are off: butterfly sleeves stand on the shoulders of the bodice.
Sleeves are now none: cap sleeves need both shoulders, and a halter leaves the shoulders bare.
The halter straps are off: cap sleeves need both shoulders.
Flutter sleeves are made in sheer chiffon, so her arm shows through. Change it under "Sleeves made of". The one-shoulder strap is off: flutter sleeves need both shoulders.
The wide straps are off: the illusion neckline's sheer tulle already runs over the shoulders.
This neckline has no strap, so a narrow strap is added on her left shoulder to hold the side cape.
The side cape now hangs from this strap (no extra narrow strap).
Each cape is fastened on a narrow strap over the shoulder, with a small brooch.
A narrow strap is added to hold the pair of shoulder capes: this neckline has none.
A plunge to the waist needs straps to stay in place, so spaghetti straps are added, and sheer modesty mesh fills the plunge between the cups.
The lined cups follow the plunge.
Sheer modesty mesh fills the plunge between the cups, so the bodice stays in place.
Sheer modesty mesh fills the plunge between the cups, so the bodice stays in place.

An illusion neckline runs up from lined cups, so the plunge is now a V-neck with sheer tulle above the cups. The halter straps are off: the illusion neckline's sheer tulle already runs over the shoulders.
Sheer modesty mesh fills the plunge between the cups, so the bodice stays in place.
The wide straps are off: an off-shoulder neckline takes off-shoulder straps only.
The top edge is plain again: a scalloped edge is for strapless necklines.
A scalloped edge is for a strapless sweetheart or straight-across neckline.
The off-shoulder straps are off: they don't go with this neckline.
The off-shoulder straps are off: a high neck covers the shoulders.
A plunge to the waist needs straps to stay in place, so spaghetti straps are added, and sheer modesty mesh fills the plunge between the cups.
Spaghetti straps now: spaghetti straps don't go with a plunge to the waist.
